responsibilities: Architect an end-to-end BI landscape including datasets, pipelines, ETL, and data visualization to support business operations.
Create new reporting for business reviews, analyzer tools, and emerging strategy efforts.
Improve auditing tools to identify gaps in technology systems and enable new capabilities.
Build insights-oriented visualization tools in Tableau or similar to enhance decision-making.
Challenge existing processes with data-driven alternatives that improve scalability and efficiency.
Partner with cross-functional teams to create and scale intelligence roadmaps that drive automation, scale, and productivity.
Develop and maintain a knowledge repository for business intelligence as part of a growing center of excellence.
Assist stakeholders in managing business operations.
Join meetings to discuss issues, solutions, and progress.
Partner with team members to design and implement BI solutions.
Write SQL queries to pull, validate, and structure data sets.
Ensure deliverables are completed on time and meet expectations.
Collaborate with a team of 5 members, with high interaction from day one until able to work independently.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Write SQL queries to pull, validate, and structure data sets.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD has little framing language either way; validation and auditing tasks ("Improve auditing tools to identify gaps") outweigh the absent speed language.
evidence.domain_risk: Opportunity to impact a high-revenue subscription program supporting recurring customer engagement.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Reporting for a subscription programme drives business decisions without regulatory or financial-reporting stakes, so it is moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Develop and maintain a knowledge repository for business intelligence as part of a growing center of excellence.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A five-person strategic data team inside a "growing center of excellence" is a mid-stage function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Architect an end-to-end BI landscape including datasets, pipelines, ETL, and data visualization to support business operations.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Some bullets name concrete work (Tableau tools, SQL validation), others are generic ("Join meetings to discuss issues, solutions, and progress").
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Assist stakeholders in managing business operations.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The audience is business operations for a revenue-generating subscription programme.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Architectural ownership sits beside support framing ("Assist stakeholders", "until able to work independently").
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The JD expects no AI skill from the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Beyond validating query results, no testing, data quality practice or tooling is named.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed in delivery and impact terms.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Challenge existing processes with data-driven alternatives that improve scalability and efficiency.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: New BI landscape and reporting sit beside improving existing auditing tools and processes.
evidence.work_arrangement: Flexibility for remote work, with potential for extension or conversion based on performance.
evidence.loss_aversion: No loss aversion framing detected. Note: a staffing-agency posting for an unnamed client, apparently a contract role ("potential for extension or conversion").
